blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: While multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) excels on long-horizon tasks, its performance gains remain highly sensitive to interaction constraints. Evaluating across sampling breadth $K$ and interaction depth $T$ via $Pass@(K,T)$, we show that trajectory-level RL advantages depend on sufficient turn budgets, diminishing significantly when budgets tighten. Besides, agentic RL does not uniformly elevate single-step decision quality; rather, its strength concentrates in error recovery and long-horizon resilience. To mitigate the deployment risks caused by this budget dependence, we provide a preliminary discussion on the benefits and limitations of process supervision signals and introduce BudgetMix RL as an alternative that varies interaction budgets during training. Experiments demonstrate that BudgetMix RL achieves robust performance across diverse execution settings. Project Page: https://rethinking-agentic-rl.github.io/
blocks.zh: 虽然多回合促进强化学习(RL)在长期任务上表现优异,但其业绩的提高仍然对互动制约高度敏感。 在通过美元Pass@(K,T)美元进行抽样广度和互动深度评估时,我们显示轨迹水平的RL优势取决于充足的转折预算,在预算紧缩时大幅降低。 此外,代理RL并没有统一提升单步骤决策质量;相反,其强度集中在错误回收和长视距抗御能力上。 为了减轻这种预算依赖性造成的部署风险,我们初步讨论了流程监督信号的好处和局限性,并引入了预算混合资源,作为培训期间互动预算的替代办法。 实验表明,预算混合RL在不同的执行环境中取得了强劲的业绩. 项目网页:https://rethinking-agentic-rl.github.io/

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) has recently emerged as an important paradigm for improving the long-horizon capabilities of large language model (LLM) agents ( Li et al., 2026a ; Xi et al., 2025a ) . By interacting with environments persistently, consuming feedback, and adapting subsequent actions, agents trained with RL have achieved substantial gains on multi-turn tasks (e.g., code or tool use). Despite these improvements, a fundamental question remains insufficiently understood: what capabilities does multi-turn agentic RL actually improve? Answering this question is important not only for understanding how agentic RL differs from its base model, but also for assessing whether agentic RL models remain reliable under realistic deployment scenarios.
blocks.zh: 多回合代理强化学习(RL)最近成为提高大型语言模型代理的长视距能力的重要范例(Li等,2026a; 习近平等, 2025a.). 通过持续地与环境互动,消费反馈,并调整后续行动,接受过RL培训的代理人在多回合任务(例如代码或工具使用)上取得了实质性成果. 尽管取得了这些改进,但一个根本问题仍未得到充分理解:多转动剂RL实际上提高了哪些能力? 回答这一问题不仅对了解代理人RL与其基准模型有何不同非常重要,而且对评估代理人RL模型在现实部署设想下是否仍然可靠也很重要。

blocks.en: Existing works primarily evaluate agents at the trajectory level, typically based on whether a task is completed within a given budget. Prior work on single-turn RL further uses Pass ​ @ ​ K \mathrm{Pass}@K to probe model capability boundary ( Yue et al., 2025 ) , which increases the number of independently sampled solutions. Pass ​ @ ​ K \mathrm{Pass}@K captures one dimension of test-time scaling: sampling breadth . Thus, we first apply Pass ​ @ ​ K \mathrm{Pass}@K to the evaluation of agents in § 3.1 . The results show that agentic RL models consistently outperform base models as the number of sampled trajectories k k increases. These results suggest that agentic RL effectively expands the empirical capability boundary of the base model.
blocks.zh: 现有工作主要是评估轨迹层面的代理人,通常以某一项任务是否在特定预算范围内完成为依据。 先前的单转RL工作进一步使用Pass@K\mathrm{Pass}@K来探测模型能力边界(Yue等,2025年),这增加了独立被采样的解决方案的数量. 通过 @ K\ mathrm{ Pass}@K 捕获测试时间缩放的一维: 采样宽度 。 因此,我们首先应用 Pass @ K\ mathrm{ Pass}@K 来评估§ 3.1中的代理人。 结果显示,随着被采样的轨迹kk数量的增加,代理RL模型的性能一直高于基础模型. 这些结果表明,活性RL有效扩展了基础模型的经验能力界限.

blocks.en: However, for interactive agents, there is another test-time dimension: the number of interactions allowed per trajectory ( Shen et al., 2026 ) , which captures interaction depth . Accordingly, we evaluate performance using Pass ​ @ ​ T \mathrm{Pass}@T by varying the maximum allowed interaction turns (§ 3.2 ). When we vary budget T T , an interesting phenomenon emerges: given a large budget, agentic RL models demonstrate a substantial advantage over base models. However, under tighter budgets, this advantage shrinks considerably and can even disappear or reverse on certain tasks (right-hand panel of Figure 1 ). These results suggest that the gains of agentic RL depend on a sufficient interaction budget . To ensure that this phenomenon is not merely an artifact of restrictive budgets rendering some tasks structurally unsolvable, we compute structural performance upper bounds and discuss in Appendix B.3 .
blocks.zh: 然而,对于交互代理,还有一个测试时间维度:每个轨迹允许的交互次数(Shen等,2026年),它捕捉到交互深度. 因此,我们使用 Pass @ T\mathrm{ Pass}@T 来评估性能,方法是改变允许的最大交互转弯(§3.2. 当我们改变预算 T T 时,出现了一个有趣的现象:由于预算庞大,代理RL模型显示出比基础模型具有实质性优势. 然而,在紧缩预算的情况下,这一优势会大大收缩,甚至会消失或逆转某些任务(图1右侧面板)。 这些结果表明,代理人RL的收益取决于足够的互动预算。 为了确保这种现象不仅仅是限制性预算的产物,使一些任务在结构上无法解决,我们计算结构性能的上限,并在附录B.3中讨论。

blocks.en: To further study this budget-dependent shift in capability, we analyze the step-level action quality of models before and after multi-turn RL (§ 3.3 ). Results show that, given the same state and history, RL models do not consistently produce better next-step actions and can even perform worse in certain settings. Instead, their advantage becomes more pronounced at error states and later stages of a trajectory. As illustrated in Figure 1 , multi-turn RL does not uniformly improve action quality of every step; it primarily strengthens ability of error recovery and sustain long-horizon execution, which may partly explain why RL models need a larger budget T T to demonstrate their advantages.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步研究这种依赖预算的能力转变,我们分析了在多回合RL(第3.3节)前后模型的分步动作质量。 结果表明,鉴于同样的状态和历史,RL模型不能一贯地产生更好的下一步行动,甚至在某些环境中表现更差. 相反,它们的优势在错误状态和轨迹后期变得更加明显。 如图1所显示的,多回合RL并不能统一提高每个步骤的动作质量;它主要能加强错误回收能力并维持长距离执行,这可以部分解释RL模型为什么需要更大的预算T T来展示其优点.

blocks.en: To understand this phenomenon more deeply, we perform a series of mechanistic analyses (§ 4 ). Our log-likelihood analysis (§ 4.1 ) shows that RL-generated actions remain locally plausible under the base policy, yet complete RL trajectories receive substantially higher likelihood under the RL policy than under the base policy. This suggests that multi-turn RL may improve how reliably the model composes locally plausible actions into long-horizon trajectories. This phenomenon offers a possible explanation for how RL models can surpass the empirical Pass ​ @ ​ K \mathrm{Pass}@K capability boundary of base models, even without consistently superior single-step actions to the base models. The training dynamics in § 4.2 further show how this pattern emerges progressively during training.
blocks.zh: 为了更深入地了解这一现象,我们进行了一系列的机械分析(第4节)。 我们的日志相似性分析(§ 4.1)表明,在基准政策下,RL产生的行动在当地仍然是可行的,但是在RL政策下,完整的RL轨迹得到的可能性比在基准政策下高得多。 这表明多回合RL可以改进模型如何可靠地将当地可行的行动编成长距离轨道。 这一现象为RL模型如何能超越经验性Pass@K\mathrm{Pass}@K能力边界提供了可能的解说,即使没有始终优于基模型的单步动作. 第4.2节中的培训动态进一步表明这种模式在培训期间如何逐步出现。

blocks.en: These analyses reveal a hidden risk masked by conventional trajectory-level success rates: models trained with multi-turn RL may fail to perform consistently under varying interaction budgets. Furthermore, their single-step action quality can decline, which are critical in real-world deployments involving strict budget limits or irreversible errors ( Ma et al., 2026 ; Doshi et al., 2026 ) . To address this, we provide a preliminary discussion on some candidate solutions (§ 5 ). Specifically, we examine the benefits and limitations of process supervision signals and introduce BudgetMix RL , an alternative training strategy that varies interaction budgets. Experiments show that BudgetMix RL consistently improves performance across budgets while mitigating the decline in step-level action quality (§ 5.2 ).
blocks.zh: 这些分析揭示出一种被传统轨迹水平成功率所掩盖的隐蔽风险:受过多轮转速训练的模型可能无法在不同的相互作用预算下持续运行。 此外,它们的单步行动质量可能下降,这对涉及严格预算限制或不可逆转错误的实际部署至关重要(Ma等,2026;Doshi等,2026)。 为了解决这一问题,我们初步讨论了一些备选解决办法(第5节)。 具体地说,我们审查程序监督信号的好处和局限性,并采用预算混合RL,这是一种变通的培训战略,其互动预算各不相同。 实验表明, " 预算混合 " RL始终如一地改善整个预算的绩效,同时减缓了步骤行动质量的下降(§ 5.2)。

blocks.en: 3 When Does agentic RL Outperform the Base Model?
blocks.zh: 3个 当代理RL超越了基模时?

blocks.en: We now examine whether the gains from multi-turn agentic RL can be consistently achieved, as well as its potential risks. We evaluate models with two dimensional metrics Pass ​ @ ​ ( K , T ) \mathrm{Pass}@(K,T) introduced in § 2.2 (§ 3.1 and § 3.2 ), analyze step-level action quality (§ 3.3 ), and summarize the potential risks (§ 3.4 ). We adopt GRPO as our primary RL algorithm and evaluate on four interactive benchmarks: DeepCoder-MT, BFCL, InterCode-SQL, and FrozenLake, spanning diverse domains and modalities. Additional results are reported in Appendix C and D , implementation details in Appendix A and B .

blocks.en: 3.1 Trajectory-Level Gains across Sampling Breadth
blocks.zh: 3.1 横跨取样桥的轨迹-水平收益

blocks.en: We begin by evaluating the trajectory-level performance using the Pass ​ @ ​ K \mathrm{Pass}@K . By increasing the number of independently sampled trajectories, Pass ​ @ ​ K \mathrm{Pass}@K probes the empirical capability boundary of a model, which we use to characterize how this boundary changes after multi-turn RL. As shown in Figure 2 , the RL model consistently outperforms the base model as the sampling breadth k k increases, suggesting that multi-turn RL can push trajectory-level success beyond the empirical capability boundary of base model. This contrasts with prior observations in single-turn tasks, where RL does not expand capability boundary beyond the base model. Further results are shown in Appendix C .

blocks.en: 3.2 RL Gains Shrink under Tight Interaction Budgets
blocks.zh: 3.2 RL 紧相互作用预算下的增益收缩

blocks.en: Beyond sampling breadth , we evaluate how model performance evolves with interaction depth . As shown in Figure 3 , we fix the sampling breadth at k = 8 k=8 and vary the maximum interaction turns T T . The results reveal an interesting pattern: the advantage of the RL model depends on a sufficient interaction budget . As the budget T T increases, the performance advantage of RL model over base model becomes increasingly pronounced. Conversely, under tight budgets (small T T ), this advantage diminishes, and can even reverse on certain tasks. To rule out the possibility that the performance drop at small T T is trivially caused by tasks becoming structurally unsolvable under restrictive budgets, we also compute the structural performance upper bound for each task and discuss in Appendix B.3 . Notably, at small T T , even when substantial headroom remains below this upper bound, agentic RL fails to exhibit any clear advantage over the base model. More results are shown in Appendix D .

blocks.en: 3.3 Does Multi-Turn RL Improve Step-Level Action Quality?
blocks.zh: 3.3 多回合RL是否提高分步行动的质量?

blocks.en: The phenomenon of last section motivates a question: does multi-turn RL improve action quality for each individual step? Thus we compare the step quality of the base and RL model under identical states. For each state s s , we independently sampled G = 16 G=16 actions from both policies and averaged their quality scores to reduce sampling variance and obtain a more robust estimate of action quality: a i Base ∼ π Base ( ⋅ ∣ s ) , a i RL ∼ π RL ( ⋅ ∣ s ) , i = 1 , … , G . a_{i}^{\mathrm{Base}}\sim\pi_{\mathrm{Base}}(\cdot\mid s),\qquad a_{i}^{\mathrm{RL}}\sim\pi_{\mathrm{RL}}(\cdot\mid s),\qquad i=1,\ldots,G. Strictly evaluating one-step quality is challenging because reliable process rewards remain difficult to obtain in agentic settings ( Li et al., 2026b ) . We therefore focus on two tasks with reliable step-level evaluation: (1) For FrozenLake, we use finite-horizon dynamic programming (DP) with a discount factor γ \gamma of 0.95 0.95 to compute the exact Q ∗ Q^{*} value of each step-level action under optimal continuation within the remaining interaction budget. (2) For DeepCoder-MT, the code of each step can be scored by unit-test pass rates. To isolate action quality from state visitation bias, we construct a state evaluation pool by sampling intermediate states equally from base and RL trajectories. Following experiments use Qwen3-4B trained with GRPO, with additional results presented in Appendix E.1 .

blocks.en: Agentic RL does not uniformly improve step-level action quality. We first evaluate whether agentic RL uniformly improves action quality per-step. As shown in Figure 4 , each point represents a matched state, with the x x - and y y -coordinates indicating action quality of the base and RL models, respectively. Points below the diagonal indicate superior action quality from base model, whereas points above the diagonal favor RL model. We find that the distribution does not favor the RL model and even leans slightly toward the base model. Specifically, RL achieves better step-level decision quality on only 46.8% of DeepCoder-MT states and 42.8% of FrozenLake states, with average quality no better than, even slightly below, the base model. These results demonstrate that multi-turn agentic RL does not consistently enhance single-step action and may occasionally degrade it.

blocks.en: Agentic RL excels after errors. Since the RL model does not consistently yield superior single-step decisions across every matched state, a natural question arises: why does multi-turn RL achieve marked trajectory-level performance gains? To answer this, we focus on states immediately following an error (e.g., error states), where effective recovery ability of models becomes critical. Specifically, we construct an error state pool by injecting an incorrect action at the preceding step. As shown in Figure 5 , the pattern reverses under these error states: data points shift predominantly above the diagonal, with the RL model selecting the superior action in 65.7% of cases on FrozenLake and 67.3% on DeepCoder-MT. We additionally compare the terminal success rates of RL and base models when continuing from identical error states. RL outperforms base on both FrozenLake ( 51.3 % 51.3\% vs. 38.6 % 38.6\% ) and DeepCoder-MT ( 38.5 % 38.5\% vs. 22.9 % 22.9\% ). Appendix E.4 also illustrates how the RL model corrects an erroneous tool call on BFCL. These results demonstrate that RL achieves higher action quality and continuation success on these error states. When errors occur in interaction trajectories, agentic RL demonstrates superior error recovery capabilities and resilience.

blocks.en: The RL advantage emerges later in trajectories. Finally, we examine how decision quality evolves over the course of a trajectory. We group intermediate states by turn index and define the normalized depth at turn t t as d t = t / T max ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] d_{t}=t/T_{\max}\in[0,1] , where T max T_{\max} is the maximum interaction budget. As shown in Figure 6 , the RL model shows little advantage early in execution and even underperforms the base model. As interaction proceeds, however, the gap gradually narrows and reverses. This indicates that the RL model does not make superior decisions at the beginning of a trajectory; its advantage emerges as interaction unfolds. This suggests that the step-level advantage of agentic RL is not uniform across a trajectory, but becomes more pronounced at later stages of long-horizon interaction.

blocks.en: 3.4 Risks: Real-World Deployment of Agents
blocks.zh: 3.4 风险: 实际部署特工

blocks.en: These findings highlight a deployment risk: the gains from agentic RL depend on sufficient interaction budget and may diminish or reverse under tight budgets. This is particularly concerning for tasks involving irreversible actions, such as financial or database operations ( Doshi et al., 2026 ) , where agents must make high-quality and conservative actions at each step. Yet higher trajectory success does not ensure better individual actions. As LLM agents are increasingly deployed in real-world settings, understanding such limitations beyond final task success becomes increasingly important.
blocks.zh: 这些结论突出了部署风险:从代理RL获得的收益取决于足够的互动预算,并在紧缩预算下可能减少或逆转。 这尤其关系到涉及不可逆转行动的任务,例如财务或数据库业务(Doshi等,2026年),因为代理人必须在每一步骤采取高质量的保守行动。 然而,较高的轨迹成功并不能确保更好的个人行动。 随着LLM代理人越来越多地被部署在现实环境中,理解这些局限超越了最终任务的成功,变得越来越重要.

We keep the histories fixed and evaluate each action under base policy. As an action is a token sequence a t = ( w t , 1 , … , w t , m t ) a_{t}=(w_{t,1},\ldots,w_{t,m_{t}}) , its negative log-likelihood (NLL) is ActionNLL B ( a t ∣ h t ) = − ∑ j = 1 m t log p B ( w t , j ∣ h t , w t , < j ) . \mathrm{ActionNLL}_{\mathrm{B}}(a_{t}\mid h_{t})=-\sum_{j=1}^{m_{t}}\log p_{\mathrm{B}}\bigl(w_{t,j}\mid h_{t},w_{t,<j}\bigr). blocks.en: To more directly examine how multi-turn RL affects step-level action quality and trajectory-level performance, we further analyze the training dynamics. Standard agentic RL is optimized and validated using trajectory reward R multi R_{\mathrm{multi}} . For tasks with step-level quality measures (§ 3.3 ), we track the average step reward R single R_{\mathrm{single}} as a validation for step-level action, while training optimizes only on R multi R_{\mathrm{multi}} . As shown in Figure 8 (red and blue curves) , we find a phenomenon: as training proceeds, the trajectory-level reward R multi R_{\mathrm{multi}} keeps rising while the per-step reward does not improve and even gradually declines. On DeepCoder-MT, R multi R_{\mathrm{multi}} rises by 0.331 0.331 while R single R_{\mathrm{single}} drops by 0.097 0.097 . This indicates that the phenomenon observed at the final checkpoint is not incidental, but rather emerge progressively during training (More results in Appendix E.3 ). This echoes our earlier findings: trajectory-level gains can develop alongside declining step-level action quality.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion: Towards More Stable Agentic RL
blocks.zh: 5 讨论:实现更稳定的RL

blocks.en: The preceding sections indicate that the gains of agent RL rely on sufficient interaction budgets, while local action quality does not consistently improve and can even decline. This raises reliability concerns for real-world deployment. Consequently, this section offers a preliminary discussion on potential mitigation strategies . Our objective is to preserve its long-horizon execution capabilities and and trajectory-level gains while reducing its reliance on extra interaction budget for downstream error recovery and encouraging greater prudence in single-step decision making.
blocks.zh: 前几节表明,代理人RL的收益依赖于足够的互动预算,而地方行动质量并没有持续改善,甚至可能下降. 这引起了对现实世界部署的可靠性的关切。 因此,本节将初步讨论可能的缓解战略。 我们的目标是保持其长距离执行能力和轨迹水平的收益,同时减少对下游故障回收的额外互动预算的依赖,并鼓励在单步决策方面更加谨慎。

blocks.en: 5.1 High-quality Process Signals Can Partly Mitigate this Risk
blocks.zh: 5.1 高质量的进程信号可以部分减轻这一风险

blocks.en: A natural direction is to introduce finer-grained signals to improve per-step action quality through either process rewards or credit assignment. We therefore evaluate several methods to examine whether step-level signals can alleviate above limitations. As shown on the left of Figure 9 , on FrozenLake, accurate process supervision can substantially mitigate the limitations of outcome-only RL. In particular, oracle Q-value process rewards and GiGPO stabilize performance across various interaction budgets, especially under tight budgets. However, as discussed in § 3.3 , such precise process supervision is rarely accessible in realistic agent tasks. Results of BFCL on the right illustrate this bottleneck, where no exact step-level oracle is available. Dense signal methods such as GiGPO and PPO fail to enhance performance under constrained budgets and perform similarly to GRPO. These findings demonstrate that while high-quality process rewards can alleviate budget reliance, acquiring such supervision signals remains impractical for most real-world applications .
blocks.zh: 一个自然的方向是引入更精细的纹理信号来通过流程奖励或信用分配来提高每步动作的质量. 因此,我们评价了几种方法,以审查步级信号是否能够减轻超出限制的程度。 如图9的左边所显示的,在"冰冻湖"(FrozenLake)上,准确的流程监督可以大大地减轻只见结果的RL的限制. 特别是,甲骨文Q-价值进程奖励和GIGPO稳定了各种互动预算的业绩,特别是在紧缩预算下。 然而,正如第3.3节所讨论,在现实的代理任务中,这种精确的程序监督很少可以使用。 BFCL在右边的结果说明了这个瓶颈,那里没有确切的阶梯级甲骨文. GIGPO和PPO等感应信号方法未能提高受限制预算下的业绩,其性能与GRPO类似. 这些调查结果表明,虽然高质量的流程奖励可以减轻预算依赖,但获得这种监督信号对于大多数现实世界的应用来说仍然不切实际。

blocks.en: 5.2 BudgetMix RL: Optimizing RL across Interaction Budgets
blocks.zh: 5.2 预算 混合 RL:优化交互预算的 RL

blocks.en: We therefore take a simpler route: BudgetMix RL . It keeps the same reward mechanism as traditional multi-turn RL, but varies the interaction budget across training trajectories. BudgetMix RL can be combined with existing agentic RL algorithms (e.g., GRPO, PPO, and GiGPO). Standard multi-turn agentic RL samples trajectories under a fixed maximum budget T max T_{\max} and optimizes either outcome or per-step rewards. However, this objective does not explicitly distinguish solutions that require different amounts of interaction, provided they finish within the budget. BudgetMix makes a single modification to this procedure. blocks.en: 6.1 Multi-Turn Agentic Reinforcement Learning
blocks.zh: 6.1 多轮辅助强化学习

blocks.en: LLM agents are widely used for interactive tasks like coding and tool use ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Qian et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Hao et al., 2026a ; Men et al., 2025 ) , with RL becoming a major training paradigm ( Jin et al., 2026a ; Zhu et al., 2026a ) . Many methods extend single-turn outcome-based RL ( Yu et al., 2025 ) to interactive tasks using trajectory-level rewards ( Xi et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2025d ) , enabling applications such as deep research ( Jin et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2026 ) , tool-augmented reasoning ( Feng et al., 2025a ) , and web interaction ( Qi et al., 2025 ) . However, sparse terminal rewards make credit assignment increasingly difficult as interaction horizons grow ( Tao et al., 2026 ; Tan et al., 2026 ) . To address this, methods derive process signals from outcomes ( Liu et al., 2025b ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) , including state-grouped advantages in GiGPO ( Feng et al., 2025b ) , stepwise reward decomposition in SPA-RL ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , and advantage attribution with entropy-guided exploration in ARPO ( Dong et al., 2025 ) . Other work explicitly models intermediate decision quality ( Xi et al., 2025b ; Lin et al., 2026 ) . Despite these advances, evaluation remains largely centered on trajectory-level success ( Li et al., 2026c ; Men et al., 2026 ; Jin et al., 2026b ) . We therefore analyze multi-turn RL beyond final task success to better understand its gains and limitations.

blocks.en: 6.2 Understanding and Rethinking RL Post-Training
blocks.zh: 6.2 了解和反思RL培训后

blocks.en: Recently, post-training has become a key stage to improving reasoning and planning capabilities of LLMs ( Guo et al., 2025 ) , prompting studies of its mechanisms and limitations ( Zhu et al., 2026b ; He et al., 2025 ; Fu et al., 2026 ) . For single-turn reasoning, Pass@ K K analyses suggest that RLVR primarily reweights solutions already reachable by the base model ( Yue et al., 2025 ) . Later work reports boundary expansion with prolonged RL ( Liu et al., 2025a ) , while others attribute apparent gains to recombining existing skills ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) or amplifying latent base-model behaviors ( Wu et al., 2026 ) . These findings suggest that final success may obscure the source of RL gains. Other studies examine entropy dynamics ( Cui et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026a ) , identify high-entropy tokens as key carriers of learning signals ( Wang et al., 2025b ) . Related work further compares SFT and RL in generalization and capability acquisition ( Chu et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2026b ) . Mechanistic analyses have recently extended to multi-turn agents ( Wang et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026a ; Hao et al., 2026b ) . Most relevantly, prior work introduced Pass@ ( K , T ) (K,T) to characterize multi-turn capability boundaries and showed that agentic RL can surpass capability boundary of base model ( Zhai et al., 2026 ) . We go beyond this perspective by analyzing interaction-budget dependence, step quality and mechanisms to identify the sources of RL gains and potential limitations.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We revisit the benefits of multi-turn agentic RL beyond final task success. Through Pass ​ @ ​ ( K , T ) \mathrm{Pass}@(K,T) evaluation, we demonstrate that RL can extend the empirical capabilities of the base model, though this advantage may diminish or reverse as interaction budgets become more constrained. Our analysis suggests that these gains stem primarily from long-horizon execution and error recovery, rather than consistently superior single-step actions. As this may impact the reliability of agents deployed in real-world settings, we further discuss potential strategies to mitigate this risk and their limitations.

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This work studies the capabilities and limitations of multi-turn reinforcement learning for LLM agents, with particular attention to their reliability under different interaction constraints. Our experiments are conducted on benchmark environments covering tool use, interactive coding, planning, and terminal operations. We do not conduct human-subject experiments in this study. Our analysis highlights a potential deployment risk: the gains of agentic RL can shrink under tight interaction budgets, while single-step action quality of RL models does not consistently improve. This limitation can be particularly relevant in applications involving strict interaction budgets or irreversible actions. We therefore believe that agentic systems should be evaluated not only by final task success, but also by their robustness across execution constraints and the reliability of individual decisions.
blocks.zh: 这项工作研究了LLM剂的多回合强化学习的能力和局限性,并特别关注它们在不同的相互作用制约下的可靠性. 我们的实验是在涵盖工具使用、交互式编码、规划和终端操作的基准环境上进行的。 我们不在本研究中进行人类实验。 我们的分析突出了一种潜在的部署风险:在严格的互动预算下,代理人RL的收益可以收缩,而RL模型的单步动作质量并没有持续改善. 这种限制在涉及严格互动预算或不可逆转行动的申请中可能特别相关。 因此,我们认为,不仅应该通过最后任务的成功,而且应该通过执行限制和个别决定的可靠性来评价代理系统。

blocks.en: A.1 Tasks and Training Data

blocks.en:
We train and evaluate agents on five representative tasks, covering tool calling, interactive code generation, embodied planning, terminal operations.
For BFCL ( Patil et al., 2025 ) , we use executable tool environments and interaction trajectories from EnvFactory ( Xu et al., 2026b ) as training data, with downstream evaluation restricted to BFCL.
For DeepCoder-MT, we construct multi-turn code generation tasks from DeepCoder ( Luo et al., 2025 ) programming problems: at each turn, the model can submit a candidate program, inspect unit-test feedback, and revise the program in subsequent turns.
For FrozenLake, we independently generate training and test maps, ensuring that the two splits are disjoint.
For Terminal-Bench 1.0 ( Merrill et al., 2026 ) , we use the training tasks provided by Tmax ( Ivison et al., 2026 ) .
For InterCode-SQL ( Yang et al., 2023 ) , we construct interactive SQL training environments from the Spider training set ( Yu et al., 2019 ) and evaluate on a separate split.

blocks.en: We consider Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) and three RL algorithms: GRPO ( Guo et al., 2025 ) , GiGPO ( Feng et al., 2025b ) , and PPO ( Schulman et al., 2017 ) . GRPO and GiGPO do not use value networks, whereas PPO trains a separate critic to estimate state values. GiGPO derives step-level credit assignment from terminal rewards and recurring environment states. Neither GiGPO nor PPO requires an additional external process reward model. Our implementation builds on the VeRL framework ( Sheng et al., 2024 ) , and we thank its developers for their excellent work.

blocks.en: Some tasks may become structurally unsolvable under overly restrictive budgets. To clarify that our findings in the main text are not driven by this constraint, we also plot the structural performance upper bound for each task at each budget. For FrozenLake, we compute the shortest path for each task instance and use it to determine the structural performance upper bound under a given interaction budget. For BFCL, we estimate this upper bound using the officially annotated ground-truth tool-call trajectories. For DeepCoder and InterCode-SQL, each turn consists of a complete code submission, meaning that every instance is, in principle, solvable within a single turn; their structural upper bounds therefore remain at 100%. As shown in Figure 10 , at small T T , these upper bounds, shown by the gray lines, decrease on some tasks, notably FrozenLake and BFCL. Nevertheless, substantial headroom remains for both models, yet RL still shows no advantage over base model. This supports our conclusion that the gains of agentic RL depend on sufficiently generous interaction budgets.
blocks.zh: 有些任务在过于限制性的预算下可能无法在结构上解决。 为了澄清我们在正文中的结论并非受这一制约因素所驱动,我们还为每项预算的每项任务制定了结构业绩上限。 对于FrozenLake,我们计算每个任务实例最短的路径,并用它来确定特定交互预算下的结构性能上绑定. 对于BFCL,我们使用官方附加说明的地面真实工具调用轨迹来估计这个上行线. 对于DeepCoder和InterCode-SQL来说,每个转弯都包含一个完整的代码提交,这意味着每个实例原则上在一个转弯内可以溶解;因此其结构上方界限保持在100%. 如图10所示,在小T T 上,这些上行线由灰色线所显示,在一些任务上,主要是"冻拉克"和"BFCL"上会减少. 尽管如此,这两个模型都保留了很大的头室,然而RL仍然没有显示比基模型更有利的. 这支持了我们的结论,即代理RL的收益取决于足够慷慨的互动预算。

blocks.en: B.4 Local Decision Quality at Matched States
blocks.zh: B.4 匹配国家的地方决策质量

blocks.en:
As described in § 3.3 , we extract intermediate states from complete base and RL trajectories and construct a state pool with equal contributions from the two policies to mitigate bias.
Each state includes the current observation and the history.
For each state, we sample G = 16 G=16 next-step actions from each policy and estimate its single-step decision quality by the sample mean of the corresponding action values.
For FrozenLake, we use the known deterministic transition dynamics of the environment to compute the exact Q ∗ Q^{*} value of each candidate action via finite-horizon dynamic programming (DP) or breadth-first search (BFS).
For DeepCoder-MT, we execute each candidate program independently and use its pass rate on the official unit tests as the action-quality measure.
blocks.zh:
正如第3.3节所描述的那样,我们从完整的基数和RL轨迹中提取中间态,并构建一个州池,从两项政策中做出同等贡献来减少偏差.
每个州都包含目前的观察和历史.
对于每个州,我们从每个政策中抽取G=16G=16下步动作,并用相应动作值的抽取平均值来估计其单步决定质量.
对于FrozenLake,我们利用已知的环境决定性过渡动态来通过有限视距动态编程(DP)或广度-第一搜索(BFS)计算每个候选动作的准确Q*QQ值.
对于DeepCoder-MT,我们独立地执行每个候选程序,并以官方单位测试的通过率作为动作质量的度量.

blocks.en: B.5 Error-State Construction
blocks.zh: B.5 错误-国家建设

blocks.en: We construct error states to evaluate single-step decision quality as follows.
blocks.zh: 我们构建错误状态来评价单步决定质量如下.

blocks.en: For FrozenLake, we select a random intermediate state s t s_{t} along a trajectory and execute a randomly chosen action a t a_{t} . If the action increases the shortest-path distance to the goal, we regard the resulting state as worse than the preceding state and include it in the error-state pool.
blocks.zh: 对于FrozenLake,我们沿着轨迹选择一个随机的中间状态 s t s_{t} 执行随机选择的动作 a t a_{t}. 如果动作能增加离目标最短的路程,那么我们认为结果的状态会比之前的状态更糟糕,并将其列入出错状态池.

blocks.en: For DeepCoder-MT, we use Qwen3-1.7B to modify the code at a randomly selected intermediate state. If the modified program passes fewer unit tests than the original program, we regard this as a degradation in code quality and use the resulting state for subsequent evaluation.
blocks.zh: 对于DeepCoder-MT,我们使用Quen3-1.7B在随机选择的中间状态来修改代码. 如果修改后的程序通过比原程序更少的单位测试,我们认为这是代码质量的下降,并使用由此产生的状态进行后续评价.

blocks.en: Both constructions serve as proxies rather than rigorous definitions of error states.
blocks.zh: 这两种构造都起到代理作用,而不是对错误状态的严格定义.

blocks.en: B.6 Effect of Process Supervision Signals
blocks.zh: B.6 过程监督信号的效果

blocks.en: In § 5.1 of the main text, we preliminarily investigate whether high-quality process supervision can alleviate the dependence of agentic RL gains on interaction budgets. On FrozenLake, we use oracle Q Q -values as process rewards, following the same procedure as in § 3.3 : we compute the Q Q -value of each action via finite-horizon dynamic programming. For both tasks, we additionally explore using an LLM judge as a process reward model to provide step-level supervision. Specifically, we use GPT-5.6-Sol as the judge model with the prompt shown in Table 3 . Our results show that even a strong judge model cannot consistently provide high-quality process supervision across all tasks, particularly in more realistic settings such as BFCL.
blocks.zh: 在正文第5.1节中,我们初步调查高质量的流程监督是否能够减轻代理RL收益对互动预算的依赖. 在FrozenLake上,我们使用oracle Q - 值作为过程奖励,遵循与§3.3相同的程序: 我们通过有限-视距动态编程计算每个动作的Q - 值. 对于这两项任务,我们进一步探索使用LLM法官作为过程奖励模式,提供分级监督. 具体地说,我们使用GPT-5.6-Sol作为裁判模型,并使用表3所示的提示。 我们的结果表明,即使是一个强有力的法官模式,也无法始终如一地对所有任务提供高质量的流程监督,特别是在BFCL等更现实的环境中.

blocks.en:
Whereas the main text primarily reports results with outcome-only GRPO, this section examines GiGPO and PPO.
Both provide process-level learning signals:
GiGPO derives finer-grained credit assignment from outcome rewards, while PPO trains a critic to provide denser learning signals.

blocks.en:
Figure 15 and 16 reveal an interesting contrast.
FrozenLake is a relatively simple, idealized environment in which single-step decision quality and process rewards can be evaluated reliably.
On this task, both GiGPO and PPO alleviate, to varying degrees, the Pass ​ @ ​ T \mathrm{Pass}@T limitation:
rather than losing their advantage as the budget tightens, models trained with these algorithms achieve relatively consistent gains across budgets.
However, on more realistic tasks such as DeepCoder-MT and InterCode-SQL, reliable process supervision is harder to obtain, and neither algorithm effectively alleviates this limitation. This is consistent with our analysis in § 5 :
high-quality process supervision can improve single-step decision quality and stabilize gains across interaction budgets.
However, such supervision is difficult to obtain in more realistic tasks, which limits its effectiveness.

然而,在DeepCoder-MT和InterCode-SQL等更现实的任务上,可靠的过程监督更难获得,而两个算法都无法有效地缓解这一限制. 这与我们在第5款中的分析是一致的:
高质量的流程监督可提高单步骤决策质量并稳定互动预算的收益。
然而,在更现实的任务中很难获得这种监督,这限制了其效力。

As in Appendix C , we also evaluate the Qwen3 models on Terminal-Bench. Figure 18 shows that this limitation also arises in more realistic terminal tasks.

Overall, the limitations and risks we identify recur across model architectures and tasks:
the advantage of agentic RL depends on the interaction budget and is not consistently maintained across budgets.
High-quality process rewards can mitigate this limitation, but such ideal supervision is not always available in real-world tasks.
This motivates our preliminary exploration of BudgetMix RL.

blocks.en: E.1 Additional Results of Step-Level Action Quality
blocks.zh: E.1 分步行动的其他结果

blocks.en: In § 3.3 of the main text, we analyze how agentic RL affects single-step action quality. While the main experiments use GRPO, here we provide additional results with GiGPO. As shown in Figures 19 and 20 , on FrozenLake, where GiGPO can obtain informative step-level credit signals, the RL model achieves better single-step action quality than the base model at both all matched states and error states. In contrast, on DeepCoder-MT, recurring matched states are difficult to obtain, making reliable step-level credit assignment substantially harder. Consequently, the RL model again does not consistently outperform the base model in single-step action quality. These results suggest that high-quality process-level supervision can improve single-step action quality. However, such supervision may be difficult to obtain in more realistic agentic tasks.
blocks.zh: 在正文第3.3节中,我们分析代理RL如何影响单步动作质量. 虽然主要的实验使用GRPO, 在这里我们提供了额外的结果与GIGPO。 如FrozenLake上的图19和图20所示,GIGPO可以获得信息化的分级信用信号,RL模式在所有匹配状态和出错状态都比基准模式更能实现单步动作质量. 相比之下,在DeepCoder-MT中,反复出现的对应状态很难获得,使可靠的分级信贷分配更加困难。 因此,RL模型在单步动作质量方面没有一贯地超过基准模型. 这些结果表明,高质量的流程层面监督可以提高单步行动的质量。 然而,在更现实的代理任务中,这种监督可能难以实现。

blocks.en:
Similarly, we evaluate the single-step action quality of models trained with BudgetMix GRPO. As shown in Figure 21 , on randomly sampled matched states, BudgetMix RL yields a clear improvement in single-step decision quality.
Unlike standard GRPO, which does not consistently improve action quality and can even degrade it, as shown in Figure 4 of § 3.3 , BudgetMix does not exhibit such degradation and instead produces consistently higher-quality local decisions.
blocks.zh:
同样,我们评价了 " 预算混合 " GRPO培训的模型的单步骤行动质量。 如图21所示,在随机抽取的对应状态上,预算混合RL在单步决策质量上得到明显改善.
与标准GRPO不同,GRPO不能持续地提高动作质量,甚至可以降低动作质量,如§3.3的图4所示,预算 混合并不显示出这种退化,而是不断产生高质量的地方决策。

blocks.en: E.2 Additional Log-Likelihood Analysis
blocks.zh: E.2 附加日志关联分析

blocks.en: Figure 23: More log-likehood analysis of base and RL models. (a) Additional log-likelihood analysis on BFCL. (b) Cumulative LLR after length matching. Error bars indicate 95% CI.
blocks.zh: 图23:基础模型和RL模型更像日志分析. (a) 关于BFCL的额外日志相似性分析。 (b) 长度匹配后的累积LLR。 出错栏显示为95% CI.

blocks.en: In § 4.1 , we present a mechanistic analysis based on log-likelihoods, primarily on Terminal-Bench. Here, we extend this analysis to BFCL. As shown in Figure 23 (a), we observe a consistent pattern: base model assigns similar likelihoods to individual actions generated by base and RL models, yet at the trajectory level, base systematically assigns lower likelihoods to RL trajectories than to its own. These results show a substantial shift between the RL and base policies over complete long-horizon trajectories, despite similar per-token NLLs under the base policy for RL and base actions.
blocks.zh: 在§ 4.1中,我们提出一种基于日志的机械分析,主要在终端-奔驰上. 在这里,我们把这个分析扩展到BFCL. 如图23 (a)所显示,我们观察到一个一致的模式:基数模型为由基数和RL模型产生的单个动作分配出相近的可能性,然而在轨迹层面,基数系统化地为RL轨迹分配出比其自身更低的可能性. 这些结果表明,尽管在RL和基础行动的基本政策下,每条NLL与完整的长视轨迹相比,RL和基础政策之间发生了重大转变。

blocks.en: Controlling for output length. We match base and RL trajectories within each task, requiring scored output token counts to differ by at most 10% of the longer sequence. This yields 193 pairs across 89 tasks on Terminal and 283 pairs across 146 tasks on BFCL. Using the cumulative LLR from § 4.1 without token normalization, the matched difference between base and RL models is 185.9 nats on Terminal and 805.8 on BFCL, with both 95% confidence intervals above zero (Figure 23 (b)). The separation of cumulative LLRs thus helps us to partly rule out the influence of trajectory length.
blocks.zh: 控制输出长度 。 我们匹配每个任务中的基础和RL轨迹,要求得分的输出令牌计数最多以较长序列的10%相差. 这在航站楼的89个任务中产生193对,在BFCL的146个任务中产生283对. 使用从§4.1中累积的LLR而不象征性地正常化,基数和RL模型之间的相匹配差为终端185.9纳特和BFCL805.8纳特,置信间隔均高于0(图23(b))。 因此,累积LLR的分离有助于我们部分排除轨迹长度的影响。

blocks.en: Figure 24: Training dynamics of the trajectory-level reward R multi R_{\mathrm{multi}} and step reward R single R_{\mathrm{single}} .

blocks.en: In § 4.2 , we track how agentic RL affects trajectory success and single-step action quality as training progresses. Here, we provide additional training dynamics on FrozenLake. As shown in Figure 24 , under standard RL, trajectory-level reward R multi R_{\mathrm{multi}} (red curve) increases, indicating agent RL can improve trajectory success. However, single-step action quality reward R single R_{\mathrm{single}} (blue curve) does not improve and instead tends to decline. Thus, trajectory-level gains during training do not necessarily translate into better local actions. However, with BudgetMix RL, single-step decision quality R single R_{\mathrm{single}} (gray curve) remains stable or improves slightly, ending approximately 0.1 0.1 above the standard RL curve. These results suggest that BudgetMix RL can help mitigate the decline in single-step decision quality. For each of FrozenLake and DeepCoder-MT, we construct a fixed pool of 512 states from base model trajectories on held-out tasks, using multiple rollout seeds and sampling across tasks and trajectory depths to encourage diversity. Each state includes its history and remaining budget. At each validation checkpoint, we sample 8 next-step actions per state and average their quality scores over actions and states to obtain R single R_{\mathrm{single}} . All checkpoints share the same state pool and scoring protocol.
blocks.zh: 在§4.2中,我们跟踪代理RL如何影响轨迹成功和单步动作质量随着培训的进展而变化. 在这里,我们提供更多关于"冰冻湖"的训练动态. 如图24所显示,在标准RL下,轨迹级奖励R多R_{\mathrm{ multi}}(红色曲线)增加,表示代理RL可以改进轨迹成功. 然而,单步动作质量奖励R单RQQMThrm{single}(蓝色曲线)并没有改善,反而倾向于下降. 因此,培训期间的轨迹水平收益不一定转化为更好的当地行动。 然而,在"预算Mix RL"中,单步决定质量R单R_{\mathrm{single}}(gray curphy)仍然保持稳定或稍有改进,结束于标准RL曲线上方约0.1. 这些结果表明"预算混合RL"可以帮助缓解单步决策质量的下降. 对于FrozenLake和DeepCoder-MT中的每一个,我们从关于被搁置任务的基模轨迹建造了由512个状态组成的固定池,利用多出出种子和跨任务和轨迹深度的采样来鼓励多样性. 每个州都包含其历史和剩余预算. 在每一个验证检查点, 我们抽样每个州有8个下一步行动, 并平均其质量得分高于动作和状态, 所有检查站共用同一个州池和评分协议.

blocks.en: E.4 Additional Case Study Results
blocks.zh: E.4 其他个案研究结果

blocks.en:
In § 3.3 , we find that RL models produce higher-quality actions in error states, suggesting agent RL may improve error recovery.
Here, we provide a more direct case study on BFCL, examining whether models correctly revise a failed tool call in their next action. We collect trajectory prefixes containing tool-call errors (191), drawing half from RL rollouts (91) and half from base (100). Both models then take one action from each identical prefix. The RL model achieves an error correction rate of 41.4 % 41.4\% , substantially exceeding the 27.2 % 27.2\% of base model. Figure 25 illustrates a case in which the RL model removes an unsupported argument rather than repeating the same error. Together, these results provide further support for our conclusion that agentic RL strengthens error recovery and resilience.
blocks.zh:
在§3.3中,我们发现RL模型在出错状态下会产生更高质量的动作,说明代理RL可能会改进出错回收.
在这里,我们提供了一项关于BFCL的更直接的案例研究,研究模型在下次行动中是否正确修改了失败的工具呼吁. 我们收集包含取用工具调用错误的轨迹前缀(191个),从RL推出(91个)中抽取一半,从基部抽取一半(100个). 两个模型然后从每个相同的前缀中取出一个动作. RL模型实现了41.4% 41.4%的校正率,大大超过了基准模型的27.2% 27.2%. 图25说明了RL模型删除一个不支持的参数而不是重复同一错误的情况. 这些结果加在一起进一步支持了我们的结论,即代理RL可以加强错误的恢复和复原能力。
